texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we can no longer hold out any hope that they escaped capture. Unfortunately, we may never know whether they were taken alive, or whether they were spared long hours of torture at the hands of aliens by the swift release of death.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，试图降落在一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们必须假设他们要么被俘虏要么被摧毁。不幸的是，我们永远无法直到他们在永久报废之前，敌人会从他们身上榨取何等的情报。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we must assume that they were either captured or destroyed. Unfortunately, we may never know what information the enemy might have gleaned from them before their eventual demise.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]带领的隶属于秘密特种部队的英勇小队尝试在[abduction_system.GetName]星系获取一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的货船。然而他们并没有意识到他们选择的目标比预期的具有更好的武装——也没有意识到地方周边还隐藏着数艘战舰。在仓促的撤退中，他们的船只被摧毁了。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cargo vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed along with all hands as they sought a hasty retreat.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，打算在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的补给舰。然而，他们选择的目标武装水平比先前预估的要高，他们也没有预估到周边还有几艘藏匿的战舰。无人机的舰船在仓促撤退时被摧毁。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed as they sought a hasty retreat.

texts.zh:
尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，打算绑架了几个人质；然而，得益于我们的早期预警系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种蠢把戏的时候会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令了结自己的生命而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这样的情况当然也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
texts.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] to attempt to seize hostages for interrogation; however, thanks to our early warning systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were under orders to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

texts.zh:
尽管有些人担心位置外星船只入侵我们的太空，直到现在我们尚不明确[From.Owner.GetName]构成了多少威胁。似乎他们派遣了一支秘密部队来拦截我们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系的一艘货船；然而碰巧的是，我们刚好在附近有数艘隐蔽的战舰能够快速地到达现场。

敌方船只在试图逃跑的时候被摧毁了，但是那里依旧可能有一些有用的信息。
texts.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; however, in a stroke of fortune, we had several warships concealed nearby that were able to arrive on the scene quickly.

The enemy vessel was destroyed as it sought to escape, but its remains may yet yield some useful information.

texts.zh:
我们曾经评估允许未知外星舰队进入我们的太空是颇具风险的——而这已经被证明是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]偏僻的角落已经登陆了一个特工小队。然而，得益于我们的预知威胁检测系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种把戏的时候一定会三思的！

似乎敌方——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令自杀而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
texts.en:

They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were given the command to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

texts.zh:
我们早就知道允许未知外星种族进入我们的宇域会带来重大风险，现在事实证明我们的担忧完全正确。[From.Owner.GetName]几乎成功将一支小队秘密降落在[abduction_planet.GetName]地表，企图绑架多名共生体并窃取我们的技术。但他们严重低估了我们高度互联的特性。当这些入侵者违反协议的行为被识破时，立即遭到了猛烈反击。

这支由[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人组成的敌袭小队在行动失败后，似乎接到了自毁指令以避免被俘。尽管如此，这次入侵事件仍为我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]提供了大量可供研究的样本材料。
texts.en:
We knew allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and now we know how right we were to be concerned. The [From.Owner.GetName] almost found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], intent on abducting several symbionts and seizing our technology. However, they did not properly account for our intraconnected nature. The would-be raiders met with fierce opposition as soon as we recognized their violation.

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were commanded to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but in spite of that: this incursion has given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material with which to investigate them.
